title: Database Connection Timeout
description: The payments service started failing with connection timeouts to the primary PostgreSQL database.
root_cause: A network misconfiguration caused packet drops between the application subnet and the database subnet.
resolution: Reverted the recent route table changes in AWS VPC.
related_logs:
FATAL: connection to database 'payments' failed
timeout expired

title: High API Latency on Checkout
root_cause: Missing index on the orders table for the user_id column.
resolution: Added concurrent index on user_id to orders table.
related_logs: Slow query detected: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = $1

title: Authentication Failures for Mobile Clients
description: Spike in 401 Unauthorized errors for the mobile API.
root_cause: The JWT signing key was rotated but the mobile API pods were not restarted to pick up the new key from SecretsManager.
resolution: Performed a rolling restart of the mobile API deployment.

title: Redis Cache OOM
description: Redis cache eviction rate spiked and eventually crashed with Out Of Memory.
root_cause: A new feature was caching user feeds without a TTL.
resolution: Updated the application to include a 1-hour TTL on feed cache keys and scaled up the Redis instance temporarily.
related_logs: OOM command not allowed when used memory > 'maxmemory'

title: Missing Configuration Error on Startup
description: Inventory service failed to start up after deployment.
root_cause: The environment variable INVENTORY_DB_URL was missing from the helm chart values.
resolution: Added INVENTORY_DB_URL to the helm chart values and redeployed.
related_logs: KeyError: 'INVENTORY_DB_URL' not found in environment variables.

title: Upstream Payment Gateway Rate Limit Exceeded
description: Payment capture requests failing with HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
root_cause: Retry storm triggered by client-side immediate retries without exponential backoff or jitter.
resolution: Enabled exponential backoff with full jitter and circuit breaking on payment gateway client.
related_logs: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests: Rate limit exceeded for endpoint /v1/charges

title: HTTP Connection Pool Exhaustion on Notification Service
description: Notification service requests timing out with PoolTimeout errors.
root_cause: Default HTTP client max connections pool size (10) was exhausted under high notification throughput.
resolution: Increased HTTP client connection pool size to 100 and added keep-alive idle connection eviction.
related_logs: urllib3.exceptions.PoolError: Connection pool is full, discarding connection: api.mailgun.net

title: Kafka Consumer Lag Spike and Deserialization CrashLoop
description: Order processing consumer group stalled and consumer pods crash looping.
root_cause: A schema change published an unexpected string field into a legacy protobuf int32 field causing deserialization exception.
resolution: Updated consumer schema deserializer with backwards-compatible schema and skipped poison pill offset.
related_logs: com.google.protobuf.InvalidProtocolBufferException: While parsing a protocol message, the input ended unexpectedly
